title: Correct flight time
description: Essential: The student's answer for the time of flight must be 0.4 s, derived from the vertical free-fall equation.

title: Correct initial velocity
description: Essential: The student's answer for the horizontal initial velocity must be 3 m/s, derived from horizontal uniform motion.

title: Correct final speed
description: Essential: The student's answer for the final speed upon impact must be 5 m/s, derived from vector addition of horizontal and vertical components.

title: Vertical motion reasoning
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the free-fall kinematic equation to find the time of flight or vertical velocity.

title: Horizontal motion reasoning
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate horizontal distance, time, and constant velocity.

title: Vector composition
description: Important: The final speed must be found by correctly combining perpendicular velocity components using the Pythagorean theorem.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All calculated quantities should be presented with correct units (s, m/s).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly treats vertical motion as having an initial velocity or misuses signs in kinematic equations.

title: Arithmetic or formula mistake
description: Pitfall: Penalize for incorrect algebraic manipulation (e.g., solving t^2 = 2h/g) or basic arithmetic errors in the core calculations.
